source_units: turns mono, LCR, and 5.1 sources into intimate, ASMR-like stereo images while keeping the source position stable. It softens hard point-source panning and adds a clearer Air texture to the generated halo, without moving the dry source position.
AAX / AU / VST3 for macOS 11 or later
The current public macOS installer and Windows VST3 package are
. The Windows AAX package remains available separately and has not been version-verified here.
Softens the feeling of a mono, LCR, or 5.1 source being locked to one exact pan point.
Keeps the source around its pan location while giving the image a more blurred, less point-like shape.
Can give mono, LCR, and 5.1 sources a more intimate, ASMR-like stereo presence while keeping the apparent source position stable.
Works from a master insert concept, so multiple panned tracks can be softened together instead of inserting a spatial plug-in on every track.
Designed for cases where ordinary panning feels too narrow or artificial, but full reverb or obvious widening is not the goal.
control that adds audible movement and texture to the halo layer, creating a clearer sense of air without moving the source position.
Give a mono source an ASMR-like stereo presence while keeping its core position clear.
Treat multiple tracks together instead of managing one insert per source.
Add movement and texture to the halo while keeping the dry image and source position stable.
If you like using PanBlur to soften point-source panning and add a stable stereo halo, you may also want to try

. SourceField is designed for more direct control over source direction, listener perspective, surface blur, rear softening, air absorption, and proximity bass, while PanBlur remains the simpler way to add a blurred halo around mono or LCR sources.
includes bug fixes and stability refinements for the spatial-enhancer workflow.
adds 5.1 layout support so PanBlur can be used in more surround-oriented sessions. This has been added to the app, but final confirmation in some 5.1 host environments is still pending.
adds tooltips inside the plug-in, so the main controls and routing behavior are easier to understand while you are working in a session.
adds support for LCR layouts, so PanBlur can be used in sessions that route a center channel alongside left and right. The older mono/mono plug-in format has been removed.
Source Pan enabled. L/R = panned source + stereo halo.
Source Pan disabled. L/R are preserved, with halo added.
L/R are preserved. Halo is generated from C when needed.
L/R = input L/R + halo. C = mid × Center Send, default 0.
L/R pass through unchanged. C is silent.
Verification in some 5.1 host environments is still pending.
The macOS installer and Windows VST3 package are available from the download links above.
Adds 5.1 support. Final verification in some surround host environments is still pending.

Adds LCR support and removes the mono/mono plug-in format.
Makes SoundField shape and localization easier to read at small input levels. Windows AAX was also added without changing the plug-in version.

AAX / AU / VST3 für macOS 11 oder neuer

Das Master-Insert-Konzept ermöglicht die gemeinsame Bearbeitung mehrerer gepannter Spuren statt eines Spatial-Plug-ins pro Spur.
Für Situationen, in denen normales Panning zu eng oder künstlich wirkt, aber kein voller Hall oder auffälliges Widening gewünscht ist.
Regler, der der Halo-Ebene hörbare Bewegung und Textur verleiht und die Luftigkeit verstärkt, ohne die Quelle zu verschieben.

Bearbeiten Sie mehrere Spuren gemeinsam statt je eines Inserts pro Quelle.

fr: transforme les sources mono, LCR et 5.1 en images stéréo intimes de type ASMR, tout en stabilisant leur position. Il adoucit le panoramique ponctuel et ajoute une texture Air plus claire au halo généré, sans déplacer la source sèche.
AAX / AU / VST3 pour macOS 11 ou ultérieur
L’installateur macOS et le paquet Windows VST3 actuellement publics sont en
. Le paquet Windows AAX reste disponible séparément ; sa version n’a pas été vérifiée ici.
Atténue la sensation qu’une source mono, LCR ou 5.1 est fixée à un point précis du panorama.
Maintient la source autour de sa position panoramique tout en donnant à l’image une forme plus diffuse et moins ponctuelle.
Donne aux sources mono, LCR et 5.1 une présence stéréo plus intime, de type ASMR, avec une position apparente stable.
Le concept d’insert master permet d’adoucir plusieurs pistes panoramiquées ensemble plutôt que d’insérer un spatialiseur sur chaque piste.
Conçu pour les cas où le panoramique ordinaire semble trop étroit ou artificiel, sans souhaiter de réverbération complète ni d’élargissement évident.
qui ajoute un mouvement audible et de la texture au halo, créant une sensation d’air plus claire sans déplacer la source.
Du mono à une stéréo intime
Donnez à une source mono une présence stéréo de type ASMR tout en gardant son centre clairement localisé.
Traitez plusieurs pistes ensemble au lieu de gérer un insert par source.

Si vous appréciez PanBlur pour adoucir le panoramique ponctuel et ajouter un halo stéréo stable, essayez aussi

. SourceField offre un contrôle plus direct de la direction de la source, de la perspective de l’auditeur, du flou de surface, de l’adoucissement arrière, de l’absorption de l’air et des graves de proximité. PanBlur reste la méthode la plus simple pour diffuser un halo autour de sources mono ou LCR.

Для ситуаций, когда обычное панорамирование слишком узкое или искусственное, но полноценная реверберация или явное расширение не нужны.
, добавляющий слышимое движение и текстуру к слою ореола и более ясное ощущение воздуха без смещения источника.

Добавьте движение и текстуру ореолу, сохраняя стабильность сухого образа и позиции источника.

음원을 패닝 위치 주변에 유지하면서 이미지가 덜 점상이고 더 흐릿하게 느껴지도록 합니다.

마스터 인서트 개념으로, 각 트랙에 공간 플러그인을 삽입하지 않고 여러 패닝 트랙을 함께 부드럽게 처리합니다.
일반 패닝이 너무 좁거나 인위적이지만 완전한 리버브나 뚜렷한 확장을 원하지 않는 상황을 위해 설계되었습니다.
컨트롤은 헤일로 레이어에 들리는 움직임과 질감을 더해 음원 위치를 이동하지 않고 더 선명한 공기감을 만듭니다.

음원별 인서트를 관리하는 대신 여러 트랙을 함께 처리합니다.
드라이 이미지와 음원 위치를 안정적으로 유지하면서 헤일로에 움직임과 질감을 더합니다.
PanBlur로 점음원 패닝을 부드럽게 하고 안정적인 스테레오 헤일로를 더하는 것이 마음에 든다면

은 공간 인핸서 작업 흐름의 버그 수정과 안정성 개선을 포함합니다.
은 5.1 레이아웃을 추가해 더 많은 서라운드 세션에서 사용할 수 있습니다. 기능은 구현되었지만 일부 5.1 호스트 환경에서 최종 확인이 남아 있습니다.
은 플러그인에 툴팁을 추가하여 세션 작업 중 주요 컨트롤과 라우팅 동작을 이해하기 쉽게 했습니다.
은 LCR 레이아웃을 지원하여 좌우에 센터 채널을 추가한 세션에서 사용할 수 있습니다. 이전 mono/mono 플러그인 형식은 제거되었습니다.

Source Pan 비활성화. L/R을 보존하고 헤일로를 추가합니다.

L/R = 입력 L/R + 헤일로. C = mid × Center Send, 기본값 0.
L/R은 변경 없이 통과합니다. C는 무음입니다.
